item: The log line for a resume watcher that cannot start names the exception's class only
summary: resume_after_exclusive_operation runs in the finally of an exclusive operation (encrypt, restore, diagnostics bundle) that may have held a passphrase. Its start-refusal log was class-only (PR #1702) but the line for a watcher thread that could not be started went through log_failure, which scrubs only the secrets the process KNOWS and writes the rest of the exception's first line plus a traceback, so a passphrase the process did not hold yet could reach the log and the error ring the diagnostics bundle carries. The line now carries the class only. Known effect, stated: the line no longer carries a traceback (a thread that cannot be created has none worth keeping). Red on main, 1 new test. Found while reading PR #1745's logging; the coordinator ruled it a defect (R189).
